verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own cross-meeting search: AI Chat searches across your meetings, natural-language search finds insights from past calls, and transcripts are searchable across all time periods. A long-time user also reports going back to details from recorded meetings. Nothing in the evidence shows jumping to the exact moment or timestamp where something was said, and native search over summaries and notes is not explicitly documented (the Glean claim depends on a third-party tool). Missing for 10: jump-to-timestamp or playback-at-moment from search results, explicit native search over summaries and notes, independent hands-on corroboration of search quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
Upload any audio and video files, and they'll be automatically transcribed into searchable and shareable text.
